newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Two San Teh units in joint venture deal.
newsitem.headline: Two San Teh units in joint venture deal.

text.p: San Teh Ltd said on Wednesday two of its subsidiaries had signed a joint venture agreement with another Singapore company to manufacture steel shafts used in fax, photocopying and printing machines.
The joint venture will be called the Xiamen San Teh Sing Electronic Science and Technology Industry Co Ltd. It will have a registered capital of US$1.3 million, San Teh said in a statement.
The two subsidiaries are San Teh Precision Engineering Pte Ltd and San Teh Xing (China) Group Co Ltd. The third company involved is Yau Heng Autoprecision Metal Engineering Pte Ltd.
